source: 外研社版必修第二册 Unit 4 同主题完形(校园戏剧首演/计划看喜剧/做戏服/爱上歌剧/校园电影社/拍野生纪录片)。用词限 U4/初中/常见词,答案唯一,4选项同词性,与阅读关不撞文章。

passages.title: My First Time on Stage
passages.text: Today I performed in the school play, and I think I did a good (1)____ job. When I first saw all my family and friends in the (2)____, I felt both nervous and proud. At the start of rehearsals, I had not (3)____ how much hard work the play would be. Our teacher was very strict, which sometimes made me so (4)____ that I was afraid I would forget my lines. I often stayed up late at night to (5)____ my part again and again. There were moments when I felt so discouraged that I almost (6)____ up. But thanks to the support of the people around me, I slowly (7)____ my fears. When the curtain finally rose, I tried to (8)____ calm and remember every word. By the end, the whole audience began to (9)____, and I felt extremely (10)____ to everyone who had helped me. It was truly an unforgettable experience.

questions.explanation: do a good job 做得不错,固定搭配。
看戏的家人朋友坐在观众席,用 audience。
had not realised 此前没意识到,符合语境。
老师严格使我紧张到怕忘词,用 nervous。
熬夜反复练习角色台词,用 practise。
give up 放弃,固定搭配。
在支持下慢慢克服恐惧,用 overcame。
stay calm 保持冷静,固定搭配。
演出结束观众开始鼓掌,用 clap。
对帮助过自己的人感到感激,用 grateful。

passages.title: Planning a Trip to a Comedy Show
passages.text: Last weekend my friends and I decided to go to a (1)____ show in another part of the city. None of us had been there before, so we needed to make careful (2)____. First we checked online and found that the tickets were not (3)____, which was good news for students like us. Then we had to work out how to get there. Since the theatre was far away, we chose to use public (4)____ instead of taxis. Josh, who is always well organised, offered to (5)____ everything for the group. He told us where to (6)____ and what time the first bus would leave. On the night of the show, we arrived early so that we could find good (7)____. The moment the host walked onto the stage, everyone began to (8)____ loudly. The jokes were so funny that we (9)____ all evening. By the time we left, we all agreed it had been an (10)____ night out.

questions.explanation: 去看喜剧表演,用 comedy。
make arrangements 做安排,符合语境。
票不贵,对学生是好消息,用 expensive。
public transport 公共交通,固定搭配。
Josh 提出为大家安排好一切,用 arrange。
告诉我们在哪儿集合,用 meet。
早到是为了找到好座位,用 seats。
主持人上台时大家大声鼓掌,用 applaud。
笑话太好笑,我们笑了一整晚,用 laughed。
大家一致认为是难忘的一晚,用 unforgettable。

passages.title: Making the Costumes
passages.text: Behind every good play there is a team of people you never (1)____ on stage. This term I joined the group that makes the (2)____ for our school drama. At first I thought sewing clothes would be (3)____, but I soon learned how hard it really is. Each costume has to match the (4)____ of the story, so we read the script many times before we (5)____ anything. We chose soft colours for the gentle scenes and bright ones for the (6)____ moments. Our teacher showed us a few clever (7)____ for turning cheap cloth into something that looked rich and old. Sometimes a small mistake meant we had to (8)____ the whole thing and begin again. It was tiring work, but when the actors finally (9)____ our costumes on stage, I felt incredibly (10)____ of what our team had done.

questions.explanation: 幕后有些人你在台上永远看不到,用 see。
为校园戏剧做戏服,用 costumes。
起初以为缝衣服很容易,用 easy。
戏服要与故事的情绪/气氛相配,用 mood。
动手剪裁前先反复读剧本,用 cut。
与 gentle 的柔和场景相对,激动场面用亮色,用 exciting。
老师教了几招把廉价布料变华贵的技巧,用 techniques。
小错误意味着要拆掉重来,用 undo。
演员最终穿着我们的戏服上台,用 wore。
为团队的成果感到自豪,用 proud。

passages.title: Learning to Love Opera
passages.text: I used to believe that opera was only for old people, and I never (1)____ to give it a try. Then my grandmother took me to see a famous (2)____ in our city, and my opinion changed completely. As soon as the lights went down, I felt (3)____ by the sound of the orchestra. The voices were so powerful that they seemed to fill the whole (4)____. Even though I could not understand every word, the music helped me (5)____ what the singers were feeling. There were moments of love, (6)____ and sadness, all carried by the music alone. I sat on the (7)____ of my seat, afraid to miss a single note. During the most exciting scene, the audience could not help but (8)____. By the end of the evening, I was (9)____ amazed by what I had seen and heard. Now I tell my friends that opera is far more (10)____ than they think.

questions.explanation: 以前从不想尝试,用 wanted。
祖母带我去看著名歌剧,用 opera。
被乐队的声音深深吸引,用 absorbed。
歌声充满整个剧院,用 theatre。
音乐帮我理解歌者的感受,用 understand。
与 love、sadness 并列的情感,用 anger。
on the edge of one's seat 坐在座位边缘(极为投入),固定搭配。
最激动的场面观众忍不住鼓掌,用 clap。
结束时完全被震撼,用 completely。
告诉朋友歌剧比想象的有趣得多,用 appealing。

passages.title: The School Film Club
passages.text: Our school film club meets every Friday after class, and it has become my favourite part of the (1)____. Each week a different member chooses a film for everyone to (2)____ together. After the film ends, we sit in a circle and (3)____ what we have just seen. Some people love a story with a clever (4)____, while others care most about the acting. Last month we watched a film that was (5)____ on a famous novel, and we argued for an hour about whether the book or the film was (6)____. I learned that two people can watch the same story and still have very (7)____ opinions. Our teacher says this is exactly why talking about films is so (8)____. She encourages us to give reasons instead of simply saying we (9)____ or hated something. Thanks to the club, I now watch every film much more (10)____ than I used to.

questions.explanation: 电影社是我一周中最喜欢的部分,用 week。
选一部电影让大家一起看,用 watch。
看完后围坐讨论刚看的内容,用 discuss。
有人喜欢情节巧妙的故事,用 plot。
be based on 改编自,固定搭配,用 based。
争论书和电影哪个更好,用 better。
两人看同一故事却有很不同的看法,用 different。
老师说这正是谈电影有趣的原因,用 interesting。
与 hated 相对,用 loved。
现在看每部电影都比以前更仔细,用 carefully。

passages.title: Filming a Wildlife Documentary
passages.text: Making a wildlife (1)____ is far harder than most viewers imagine. To film leopards in the wild, a small team may have to (2)____ for weeks in a hot, distant place. The camera operators must stay very (3)____ so that the animals are not frightened away. Sometimes they wait all day and (4)____ nothing at all. When a leopard and her cubs finally appear, the team has only a few (5)____ to capture the perfect picture. Every member of the crew has an important (6)____ to play, from carrying the heavy equipment to checking the sound. The pictures they bring back can (7)____ the way ordinary people see nature. Many viewers, (8)____ by what they watch, begin to care more about protecting wild animals. That is why the team believes their tiring work is (9)____ worth it. A good documentary, they say, can teach more than any (10)____ book.

questions.explanation: 制作野生动物纪录片,用 documentary。
团队可能在炎热偏远处等上数周,用 wait。
必须保持安静以免吓跑动物,用 quiet。
有时等一整天却什么也看不到,用 see。
豹子出现时只有几分钟抓拍,用 minutes。
have a part to play 各司其职,固定搭配,用 part。
这些画面能改变普通人看待自然的方式,用 change。
许多观众被所看内容打动(被动),用 moved。
团队相信辛苦的工作当然值得,用 certainly。
好纪录片比任何课本教得更多,用 textbook。
